literal: To those who fight, far will not depart joy, wisdom lacking, fearing enemies if they obtain.
translation: If one obtains enemies who lack wisdom and are easily frightened, joy will never depart far from those who oppose them.
modern: அறிவில்லாத, பயப்படுகின்ற பகைவர்களைப் பெற்றால், அவர்களை எதிர்த்துப் போரிடுபவர்களுக்கு மகிழ்ச்சி எப்போதும் நீங்காமல் நிலைத்திருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the strategic advantage of facing weak adversaries. If a person's enemies are both foolish and cowardly, defeating them becomes an effortless task. Consequently, those who oppose such weak enemies will experience constant success and happiness. The phrase 'cēṇ ikavā iṉpam' beautifully conveys that joy will never go far away from them, as victory is guaranteed.
